pivot_reason: All completed-bar attention, breadth, state-first ML and cross-asset SMT screens failed. The experiment changes to checksum-verified native BBO and aggTrade event states on separated dates.

data.source: public GitHub Actions artifacts from checksum-verified official Binance Vision USD-M bookTicker and aggTrades
data.row_contract: completed one-second state; entry is first native BBO strictly after second end
data.outcome_fields: long/short gross BBO returns and exit timestamps are labels/execution outcomes only and never decision inputs

VACUUM_CONTINUATION.requirements: ofi_5 and flow_imb_5 aligned; microprice or L1 imbalance aligned; aggressive flow is not being replenished on the opposite side

ABSORPTION_REVERSAL.requirements: large five-second aggressive flow with low directional price progress, opposite one-second OFI and opposite microprice/book state

FLOW_REACCEPTANCE_CATCHUP.requirements: persistent 30-second flow, fresh same-direction one-second flow and OFI, while the 30-second price move has not yet followed the flow

signal_deduplication: within each symbol and mechanism, emit only false-to-true state transitions and require five completed seconds before rearming

execution.global_position: at most one BTC/ETH position; the highest normalized mechanism score wins simultaneous entries
execution.exit: the horizon is a signal-decay candidate chosen on development only; validation uses the frozen horizon
execution.promotion_limit: fixed-horizon BBO results are discovery evidence only; any survivor requires raw native-tick barrier and adverse-fill reconstruction before Champion comparison

selection.validation_open_condition: one frozen rule per mechanism passes every development and selection gate
selection.validation_pass: both validation dates positive at 12bp, aggregate PF at least 1.20, aggregate 18bp positive, at least 60 trades, top-five share at most 0.35
